top_signals.title: Special Bonus Pool for Goldman Executives to Top $500 Million
top_signals.summary: Goldman Sachs executives including CEO David Solomon and President John Waldron are set to take in a special bonus. Equity awards could top $500 million based on the current share price. Solomon could get $100 million alone. Bloomberg's Sridhar Natarajan reports. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: No DRAM but plenty of good drama in Asia
The EU budget continues delivering for Europe in 2025
top_signals.summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 08 Oct 2026 Today, the Court of Auditors (ECA) published its Annual Report, giving the EU's annual accounts a clean bill of health for the 19th consecutive year. The ECA confirmed that the collection of EU revenues was free from material error.
